title: The next frame of the GIF may only update the local rectangle
summary: The image descriptor gives the frame origin and size within the logical screen. Compositing also depends on how the preceding frame is disposed of.
applies: GIF89a image data and graphics control extension
detail: Solution 2: Restore the corresponding area to the background color, 3: Restore it to the state before displaying the graphic.
boundary: The transparent index means that the pixel does not modify the existing canvas; it cannot simply cover the previous color with transparent black.
relevance: Explain the situation where incomplete images are obtained when reading only a single frame, but complete text is displayed when playing.
